result_text:
A sub-landscape with a missing or unreadable `config.json` no longer aborts the parent report. Its row still renders with the link to its index page and the default landscape logo, and the other rows are unaffected. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or add one for this case.

The fix is in `LandscapeReportGenerator.java`, in the Sub-landscapes table loop. `getSubLandscapeConfig` returns null when the file can't be read, and the loop then called `getMetadata()` on that null. It now falls back to an empty `Metadata` when the config or its metadata is null. An empty `Metadata` has no logo link, so the existing code picks the default logo. Sub-landscapes that do have a config keep their own logo.
